messages:
ravi_cs: Just wrapped Greenleaf onboarding call — short recap: they reported search/embeddings returning outdated results after dataset updates. Also asked for per-route billing visibility and route-level RBAC. Renewal conversation in ~8 weeks, so leaning urgent.

dionne_cs: TL;DR: Embedding staleness (customer sees old KB content for ~18hrs post-reindex), Per-route cost visibility request from finance, Need route-level RBAC for segmented teams, Admin UX: bulk invites/token flow confusing (filed a ticket). Marking staleness as highest risk.

opsbot: New ticket created: CS-4821 (bulk invite/token UX). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4821 — tags: customer-greenleaf, impact:high

elena_prod: Thanks. Can you paste the exact reindex command + sample query they used? Also did they run with cache disabled on client side?

ravi_cs: Provided sample: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/reindex -d '{"dataset":"greenleaf-kb"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' && curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/search -d '{"route":"greenleaf-kb","query":"how to enable per-route billing"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'``` They said they toggled client cache off and still saw old results. Reindex time: 2026-02-18T16:32:10Z.

sam_pm: If reindex doesn't trigger KV / prefix invalidation in the serving layer, queries could hit stale cached vectors. @elena_prod any hunch?

elena_prod: Hypothesis: index update event not propagating to LRU/KV cache invalidation. Need to check (1) reindex event emitted on control-plane, (2) runtime processed event and cleared relevant keys. If missing, we can add event fanout to invalidate on reindex. Quick triage plan: ask CS for logs, check event bus, check runtime metrics around 16:32Z. ETA for small patch: 2 engs, ~3 business days incl. safety checks.

dionne_cs: I'll collect logs and request permission to run a manual cache-invalidate from ops if needed. Customer impact: blocking for two paid features they planned to launch. They'll expect weekly updates.

ravi_cs: I've dropped a short requirements doc for per-route billing visibility here: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/greenleaf-per-route-cost. Suggest priority: Embedding staleness = P0 (renewal risk), Billing visibility = P1, Route RBAC = P2, Admin invites UX = P2.

sam_pm: I'll push staleness into next sprint triage. If ops can run a targeted cache flush as temporary mitigation that could reduce renewal pressure. @elena_prod can you confirm whether we have a safe invalidate endpoint we can run for them?

elena_prod: Yes — internal endpoint exists for emergency cache invalidation. Prefer to validate via logs first. If logs confirm missing invalidation, we can (a) run manual invalidate and (b) schedule the automated fanout fix.

dionne_cs: Greenleaf ok'd log sharing and manual invalidate if it helps. They're asking for a short runbook so their SREs can request the operation during business hours. Adding Solutions/Support to the loop for runbook drafting.

ravi_cs: I'll create a weekly status thread and draft a one-page runbook template for Solutions. Will also surface the renewal risk to AM. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
